reproducer.controlGenerator: function adversarial(){let seed=61727,draws=0;function random(n){seed=(Math.imul(seed,1664525)+1013904223)>>>0;draws++;return seed%n}const m=6;function calc(F,a){let bad=0,zero=0;for(let c of F){let k=0,s=0;for(let l of c)if(Boolean(a>> (Math.abs(l)-1)&1)===(l>0)){k++;s+=Math.sign(l)}if(!k)bad++;else if(s%3===0)zero++}return[bad,zero]}function climb(F,res){let a=0,trace=[];for(;;){let cur=calc(F,a),best=null;for(let v=1;v<=m;v++){let q=a^(1<<(v-1)),[bad,zero]=calc(F,q);if(bad>=cur[0])continue;if(!best||bad<best.bad||bad===best.bad&&res&&zero<best.zero)best={v,q,bad,zero}}if(!best)return{a,bad:cur[0],trace};a=best.q;trace.push(best)}}for(let i=0;i<50000;i++){let F=[];for(let j=0;j<15;j++){let s=new Set;while(s.size<3)s.add(1+random(m));let c=[...s].map(v=>random(7)<3?-v:v);F.push(c)}let plain=climb(F,false),res=climb(F,true);if(plain.bad===0&&res.bad>0){let solutions=[];for(let a=0;a<2**m;a++)if(calc(F,a)[0]===0)solutions.push(a);return{F,plain,res,solutions,draws,trials:i+1}}}return{draws,notFound:true}}
